classes.name: BasketService
classes.description: Implements the IBasketService interface, providing basket management functionalities such as add, delete, update, and transfer baskets.

methods.name: AddItemToBasket
methods.description: Adds an item to the basket for the specified user, creating the basket if it doesn't exist, and updating or adding items accordingly.

methods.name: DeleteBasketAsync
methods.description: Deletes a basket by its ID, retrieving the basket and removing it from the repository.

methods.name: SetQuantities
methods.description: Updates quantities of items in a basket based on provided dictionary, adjusts item quantities, and removes empty items.

methods.name: TransferBasketAsync
methods.description: Transfers the basket contents from an anonymous session to a user account by copying items and updating repositories.
